question: What immunity to poison is attained in the body even after bites from great serpents?
premises: The body may be bitten by great serpents.
Poison would normally enter the body.
In this case poison does not enter.
inference: Through this attainment, poison does not enter the body even when bitten by great serpents.
plain_english: Poison does not enter the body, even if one is bitten by great serpents.
